# `csharp_blank_lines_inside_type`

Blank lines below the opening brace and above the closing brace of a type.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `0`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int X { get; set; }
    public void Run() { }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{

    public int X { get; set; }
    public void Run() { }
}
```
:::

::::

*Setting shown: `csharp_blank_lines_inside_type = 1`*
